environment.description: IoT message ingestion service deployed on EC2 instances behind a public-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) in us-east-1. The ALB has a public DNS name (iot-ingest-prod-1234567890.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com) with TLS termination. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. MongoDB Atlas cluster accessible via peered VPC. No request body inspection or WAF rules attached to the ALB.

config.mongodb: Atlas M30 cluster, VPC peering, no field-level encryption
